# VPadConnect 0.2.1 Beta 4

## New Features

- Added a native PyInstaller bootloader splash screen using the supplied
  `splash.png` artwork. It appears while the one-file application starts and
  transitions to the main window after its first render.
- Moved user-facing preferences, hotkeys, custom controller mappings, and
  user-created profiles to `%APPDATA%\VPadConnect`.

## Improvements

- Added first-launch migration from the previous executable-directory and
  Local AppData layouts. The migration verifies copied files, preserves
  existing AppData data, and leaves legacy files in place for recovery.
- Kept built-in profiles and the default settings template packaged as
  read-only resources. Logs, trusted-client state, remote permissions, and
  generated TLS certificates and private keys are stored in
  `%LOCALAPPDATA%\VPadConnect`.
- Improved compatibility with installations under protected Windows
  directories by directing application-managed writes to AppData.

## Installer Compatibility

- Preserved the existing Windows x64 Inno Setup workflow, shortcuts,
  installation options, and uninstall behavior.
- Continued bundling the official ViGEmBus 1.22.0 installer and its existing
  detection and installation flow. Application uninstall does not remove the
  shared driver or user AppData.

## Validation Status

- `python -m compileall -q core ui tests main.py` passed.
- `node --check ui/web/static/app.js` passed.
- `node --test tests/test_web_frontend.cjs` passed (35 tests).
- Storage, startup, remote-security, profile, and installer-driver tests passed
  in focused runs (49 storage/startup tests and 4 installer tests).
- The full Python suite reported 155 passed and 2 existing DualSense failures:
  one gyro fixture does not set `Mapper.controller_type`, and one Lightbar test
  expects `(34, 197, 94)` while the current palette returns `(0, 255, 0)`. These
  are the same two failures documented in the Beta 3 release notes.
- The supported build script completed on Windows 11 with Python 3.12.6,
  PyInstaller 6.11.1, and Inno Setup 6.7.4. The one-file executable contains
  `Splash-00.res`, uses the Windows GUI subsystem, and has four-part file
  version `0.2.1.4`.
- The packaged executable was launched with temporary roaming/local AppData
  and an unrelated working directory. The main window rendered without a
  console, settings were created under the temporary roaming root, and a
  changed setting persisted after restart. The first screenshot was captured
  after the main window appeared, so the splash image itself and exact visual
  transition timing were not captured.
- The installer compiler log confirms that the official ViGEmBus 1.22.0
  installer is embedded. Its SHA-256 matches the build script's pinned value.
  The built setup checksum is recorded in `dist/SHA256SUMS.txt`.
- Installation under Program Files, upgrade over an existing installation,
  uninstall, and execution of the real driver installer were not exercised in
  a clean VM. The installer orchestration tests passed, but they use mocked
  driver states and do not verify a real driver install or uninstall session.
